_about: Descriptions Gemma (gemma-4-31b-it via the Gemini API) wrote during the first live runs on 7 Oct 2026, kept so the demo town's card is instant and survives the API's intermittent 500s. Everything else is generated live. One field mark was corrected by hand after checking a field guide: White Wagtail 'black cap aur face' → 'gale par kaala patch' (winter birds here have a white face and a black bib). Grow this file from GET /cache on a running instance.
